sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. Define the terms goods, services and production. (3 marks)
2. State three differences between a partnership and a cooperative society. (3 marks)
3. Name four factors of production and the reward for each. (8 marks)
4. Record the following transactions in a two-column cash book: Started business with Ksh 60,000 cash; bought goods for Ksh 25,000 cash; sold goods for Ksh 40,000 cash. (6 marks)
5. State two functions of commercial banks. (2 marks)
